data_fields.name: commit_window
data_fields.donor_constant: BASETHRESHOLD = 100, counted down per chase tick, cleared at once if target dead

data_fields.name: rear_arc_half_angle
data_fields.donor_constant: 90 degrees (ANG90 to ANG270 is the rear)

best_idea: After a monster is hit it keeps its current target for a commit window, re-aims only when that window is zero, and drops the commit at once if the target dies.
decision_why: Take the commit window with the immediate clear on target death, and the two-slot round-robin look; reject the four-way grid chase and the sound flood, which depend on DOOM grid and level geometry; the front-arc idle look is a design choice to decide, not adopt yet.
acceptance: In a three-on-one server test, a fighter hit by a second enemy keeps its first target while the commit window runs, re-aims only after the window reaches zero, and clears the window at once when its target dies; a second assertion shows one look checks at most two live fighter slots.
